parameters.name: Addr
parameters.description: The list of addresses in the address pool.

sub_parameters.name: AttributeInfo
sub_parameters.description:
The source region of the address. This parameter is a JSON string.

- lineCode: The line code of the source region.

- lineCodeRectifyType: The rectification type for the line code. Default value: AUTO.

  - NO\_NEED: No rectification is performed.

  - RECTIFIED: The line code is rectified.

  - AUTO: The line code is automatically rectified.

sub_parameters.name: Mode
sub_parameters.description:
The mode. Valid values:

- SMART: smart return

- ONLINE: always online

- OFFLINE: always offline

parameters.name: EvaluationCount
parameters.description: The number of consecutive failed health checks.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.
<props="intl">Call [DescribeDnsGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances) to obtain the instance ID.</props>

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The health check interval. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: IspCityNode
parameters.description: The list of health check nodes. If MonitorStatus is set to OPEN, you must specify at least one valid health check node.

sub_parameters.name: CityCode
sub_parameters.description:
The city code. If MonitorStatus is set to OPEN, CityCode is required.

For information about the valid values, see the response of the DescribeDnsGtmMonitorAvailableConfig operation.

sub_parameters.name: IspCode
sub_parameters.description:
If MonitorStatus is set to OPEN, IspCode is required.
For information about the valid values, see the response of the DescribeDnsGtmMonitorAvailableConfig operation.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of some returned parameters. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: LbaStrategy
parameters.description:
The load balancing policy. Valid values:

- ALL\_RR: returns all addresses.

- RATIO: returns addresses by weight.

parameters.name: MonitorExtendInfo
parameters.description:
The extended information. This parameter is a JSON string. The required parameters vary based on the health check protocol:

- HTTP and HTTPS:

  - port: The health check port.

  - host: The host settings.

  - path: The URL path.

  - code: The return code. A response with a status code greater than this value is considered abnormal. Valid values: 400 and 500.

  - failureRate: The failure rate.

  - sni: Specifies whether to enable Server Name Indication (SNI). This parameter is available only for the HTTPS protocol.

    - true: Enable SNI.

    - Other values: Disable SNI.

  - nodeType: The type of the health check node when the address pool type is DOMAIN. Valid values:

    - IPV4

    - IPV6

- PING:

  - failureRate: The failure rate.

  - packetNum: The number of ping packets.

  - packetLossRate: The packet loss rate.

  - nodeType: The type of the health check node when the address pool type is DOMAIN. Valid values:

    - IPV4

    - IPV6

- TCP:

  - port: The health check port.

  - failureRate: The failure rate.

  - nodeType: The type of the health check node when the address pool type is DOMAIN. Valid values:

    - IPV4

    - IPV6

parameters.name: MonitorStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the health check feature. Default value: CLOSE. If you set this parameter to OPEN, the health check configuration is verified. Otherwise, the configuration is ignored.

- OPEN: enabled

- CLOSE: disabled

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the address pool.

parameters.name: ProtocolType
parameters.description:
The health check protocol. Valid values:

- HTTP

- HTTPS

- PING

- TCP

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the address pool. Valid values:

- IPV4: IPv4 address

- IPV6: IPv6 address

- DOMAIN: domain name
